run_gtn_loss_example: run the pytorch GTN loss example to compute sequence criterion loss and gradients
create_target_graph: create a target graph from a token sequence where each token can align to multiple frames
compute_gtn_loss_forward: compute the forward pass of GTN loss by scoring target graphs against emissions
compute_gtn_loss_backward: compute the backward pass of GTN loss to get gradients for input tensors
use_gtn_loss_in_pytorch: use the GTNLoss function as a custom PyTorch autograd loss for sequence alignment
